mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Harriet Park with a temperature of 50 degrees, though it feels like 42 degrees outside.

Public works has announced asphalt repairs starting November 10 near Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, while the plan commission is reviewing development projects including Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park on December 7.
Today you can head to the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, with more events like trivia and yoga scheduled throughout the coming week.
Regarding local activity, on October 25, a driver was arrested for O W I after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Really Reese's flavor at Culver's, and since they are open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
